# dsa-study-packet

> Company-neutral interview-practice source for code, tests, notes, print
> material, and the reading site's synced content.

## Read Order

1. `AGENTS.md`: agent conduct, practice entry points, public boundary
2. `TRACK-CONTRACT.md`: provisional, descriptive Python practice-flow contract
   v2; validation follows G and prompt 75, preceding R, TypeScript, C++, or Rust
   implementation
3. `docs/guide/getting-started.md`: first rep walkthrough
4. `docs/guide/source-of-truth.md`: full layer and public-boundary contract
5. `CLAUDE.md`: Claude-specific overlay, secondary to `AGENTS.md`

## Just Command Surface

- Practice loop: `just practice-start comments|reacto|clarp|umpire [topic
  problem]`, `just practice-next`, `just practice-test`, `just
  practice-watch`, `just practice-repl`, `just practice-open`, `just
  practice-finish "<one fix>"`
- Study: `just practice-study topic problem` opens immutable committed source
  and test snapshots without starting a rep.
- Tests first: `just practice-start-tests topic problem` starts the normal rep
  with its candidate test tab focused.
- Talk-only or board: `just interview [topic problem]`, `just rep-finish
  topic problem "<line>"`
- Lookup: `just catalog "<words>"`
- Front doors: `just packet`, `just docs`, `just pdf-all`, `just test`, `just
  lint`, `just doctor`

## Machine Keys

Practice commands emit UPPERCASE key lines: `STATE`, `SOURCE`, `TEST`,
`NEXT`, `START`, `QUEUE`, `QUERY`, `MATCH`, `CHOOSE`, `SUGGEST`, `OPENED`,
`OPEN_FAILED`, `STUDY_SOURCE`, `STUDY_TEST`, `REVISION`, `IMPLEMENT`,
`TESTS_FIRST`, `FOCUS`, `PRACTICE`, `CLOSED`, `LOGGED`, `SPACED`, `TESTS`.
Agents relay fields verbatim. `READY`, `CHOOSE`, and `NOT_FOUND` are `STATE`
values.

## Reading Site

[dsa-woodshed.space](https://dsa-woodshed.space) syncs an exact commit and
verifies digests before build. Repo owns content; site owns shell.

## Constraints

- Public boundary: this repo is public and company-neutral. Employer names,
  interviewer notes, request numbers, clearance facts, tailored positioning,
  and personal rep logs never enter tracked files; see
  `docs/guide/source-of-truth.md`.
- Candidate work is private and gitignored. Read it only at an explicit
  save-and-continue boundary; study snapshots are read-only committed copies.
- `just` is the only front door; never invoke raw Bazel directly.
- Agents never write candidate source, tests, or private logs.
